format: docx

```{r setup}
#| include: false
# officedown-style option (tab.cap) translated into a Quarto/knitr one (fig.cap) by an opts_hook
knitr::opts_hooks$set(tab.cap = function(options) {
  options$fig.cap <- paste("FROM-OPTS-HOOK:", options$tab.cap)
  options
})
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-hooked
#| tab.cap: "my table caption"
plot(1:3)
```
